rates.label: Taxa normal

provenance.sourceText: Para as restantes importações, transmissões de bens e prestações de serviços, a taxa de 23%.

rates.notes: Código do IVA (CIVA), text as served by the Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira (AT, the Portuguese tax authority), art. 18.º n.º 1 alínea c) — PRIMARY TEXT, read directly on 2026-09-04 on https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/codigos_tributarios/civa_rep/Pages/iva18.aspx (a static HTML page served by the AT, direct curl with no JavaScript). Rate applicable to MAINLAND Portugal (Portugal continental) — see the file-level note below for Madeira and the Azores, which apply their own regional rates and are NOT modeled separately here. NO DIVERGENCE with tax-systems/data/pt.json's own TEDB fragment (already in this repository, agent P2-T02/T07: `"value" : 23.0, "situationOn" : "2026/01/01"`) nor with the fresh TEDB reading redone by this task (see the file-level notes): both sources converge on 23%.

rates.label: Taxa intermédia

provenance.sourceText: Para as importações, transmissões de bens e prestações de serviços constantes da lista II anexa a este diploma, a taxa de 13%;

rates.notes: CIVA art. 18.º n.º 1 alínea b) — the same AT page as pt-standard above, read the same day. Category REDUCED (not SUPER_REDUCED) by this catalog's own construction: it is the HIGHER of Portugal's two non-standard rates (13% and 6%), the same convention as vat-rates/data/at.json (13% REDUCED) and vat-rates/data/hr.json (13% REDUCED). Applies to the goods and services of the « Lista II » annexed to the CIVA (not transcribed here — a list of articles distinct from the body of the article itself, not reached by this task within the time available; the rate itself, 13%, is on the other hand quoted verbatim above from the very body of art. 18.º).

rates.label: Taxa reduzida

provenance.sourceText: Para as importações, transmissões de bens e prestações de serviços constantes da lista I anexa a este diploma, a taxa de 6%;

rates.notes: CIVA art. 18.º n.º 1 alínea a) — the same AT page as pt-standard above, read the same day. Category SUPER_REDUCED (not REDUCED): it is the LOWER of Portugal's two non-standard rates, below the 13% rate above, the same convention as hr-reduced-5 for Croatia. Applies to the goods and services of the « Lista I » annexed to the CIVA (not transcribed here, same limitation as pt-reduced-13 above).

notes: Portugal (2026-09-04). Three MAINLAND rates, all 'legal', SOURCED FROM THE PRIMARY LEGAL TEXT itself as served by the Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira (AT) on info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt (a static HTML page per CIVA article, direct curl, never a fetch-summary): CIVA art. 18.º n.º 1 — 23% (normal, alínea c)), 13% (intermédia, alínea b), Lista II), 6% (reduzida, alínea a), Lista I). CONFIRMS EXACTLY the task's brief (art. 18: 23/13/6 for the mainland). REGIONAL RATES, DELIBERATELY NOT MODELED HERE, documented honestly instead — CIVA art. 18.º n.º 3, read the same day, same AT page: « As Assembleias Legislativas das Regiões Autónomas dos Açores e da Madeira podem, nos termos previstos na Lei das Finanças das Regiões Autónomas, aprovada pela Lei Orgânica n.º 2/2013, de 2 de setembro, fixar taxas diminuídas do IVA aplicáveis às transmissões de bens e prestações de serviços que se considerem efetuadas nas regiões autónomas [...] » — the CIVA itself DELEGATES to the two autonomous regions the power to set their own reduced rates, BY REGIONAL LEGISLATIVE DECREES distinct from the CIVA (not reached by this task within the time available — the regional government portals of Madeira and the Azores, not explored). CURRENT VALUES, sourced SEPARATELY via the public TEDB API (Taxes in Europe Database, DG TAXUD of the European Commission — the same method already used by tax-systems/data/pt.json's own provenance for the mainland rate): POST request to https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/tedb/rest-api/vatSearch {"searchForm":{"selectedMemberStates":[24],...}}, consulted on 2026-09-04, HTTP 200 — the PT result set lists, among its « REDUCED » rates, two entries explicitly annotated by the TEDB itself: {"key":"Reduced rate","value":22.0,"comments":"[...] Madeira Autonomous Region"} and {"key":"Reduced rate","value":16.0,"comments":"[...] Azores Autonomous Region"} — that is, a REGIONAL normal rate of 22% for Madeira and 16% for the Azores (the TEDB files these two regional rates under its own « REDUCED » type because its schema only recognizes a SINGLE « STANDARD » rate per member state — a TEDB artifact, not a CIVA classification). NEITHER the intermediate rate NOR the reduced rate specific to each region (generally reported elsewhere as 12%/5% for Madeira and 9%/4% for the Azores) appears in this same TEDB result set as of the consultation date — THESE TWO PER-REGION VALUES ARE THEREFORE NOT ASSERTED HERE, for want of a source directly consulted by this task (the regional legislative decrees themselves, not reached). IN LINE WITH THIS TASK'S SCOPE (« model the mainland, document the regions in notes without modeling them unless straightforward »): NO separate VatRateFact is created for Madeira/the Azores — this note documents what was found (the legal delegation itself, verbatim and sourced to CIVA art. 18.º n.º 3; the two regional normal rates 22%/16%, sourced from the TEDB) without promoting them into entries of this catalog. ISENÇÕES (exemptions, CIVA art. 9.º/13.º/14.º, exports included) NOT MODELED: art. 14.º (read at its primary text on 2026-09-04, https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/codigos_tributarios/civa_rep/Pages/iva14.aspx) qualifies these transactions as « isentas do imposto » (exempt from the tax) — never a literally stated « taxa de 0% » — so, by the same discipline this schema.ts's own header already applies (a ZERO category requires a STATED 0% rate, not an exemption qualified some other way), no ZERO entry is added here for Portugal.
